definitions.explanation: A person of Japanese nationality or ethnicity. Can refer to individuals or collectively to the Japanese people.

examples.japanese: {日本人|にほんじん}です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{日本人|にほんじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧がいます。
{日本人|にほんじん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{礼儀|れいぎ}{正|ただ}しい→礼儀正しい：15088_reigitadashii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Japanese people are said to be polite.

notes:
{日本人|にほんじん} refers to people of Japanese nationality or descent. Formed from ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧ + ⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧ (person), following the standard pattern for nationality words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日本人|にほんじん}⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧: Japanese tourists
- {日本人|にほんじん}⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧: Japanese athlete
- {日本人|にほんじん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: as a Japanese person
- {日本人|にほんじん}⟦{離|ばな}れ→離れ：10003_banare⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧: un-Japanese (in appearance or behavior)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {邦人|ほうじん}: Japanese national (formal, used in news — {邦人|ほうじん}⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧ "protection of nationals")
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦{国籍|こくせき}→国籍：02755_kokuseki⟧: Japanese nationality (legal term)

PRONUNCIATION:
The reading にほんじん is standard. にっぽんじん is also used, especially in formal or patriotic contexts.
